references_experience.text: , necessary equipment, and sufficient financial resources to perform the required work. B. REQUIREMENTS B.1. Service Requirements The Contractor must provide printing services, including the following tasks: • Graphic design and creation of annual report content for various Embassy offices. • Graphic design and creation of brochures, information portfolios, folders, advertising publications, flyers, and similar materials for the Embassy's promotional events. • Printing and/or photocopying of documents, brochures, and portfolios in a professional manner, ensuring clear colors, photographs, text, and images for finished products. Preference will be given to contractors offering multiple printing methods, such as commercial, digital, press, and web-based printing. • Supplying stock images for publications, as needed. • Providing printing designs for requesting offices to review and confirm prior to production. The Contractor is responsible for installing, setting up, and delivering printed items to U.S. Embassy Hanoi events. • Material Requirements: The Contractor shall present several material options for the Embassy's selection prior to submitting a quote. Services must include all necessary supplies — such as equipment, toner, developer, fuser agent, staples, paper, g

d accepted under approved BPA calls during the applicable month. • The invoice must indicate delivery dates, services provided for each order, unit price, and the total amount due for the month. • Payment will be made via Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) to the Contractor's designated bank account, within 30 days of invoice receipt and acceptance of the supplies. B.7.
